about.opensourceBody: This tool is intended for learning, research, and improving local YOLO annotation, training, prediction, and assisted-labeling workflows. The goal is to lower the barrier for vision data processing while allowing developers to review the implementation, reproduce experiments, and improve it together.

train.exportParam.format: Export format. OpenVINO is for Intel inference; ONNX is for general deployment.
train.exportParam.imgsz: Input image size for the exported model. It usually matches the training image size.
train.exportParam.batch: Batch size for export. Use dynamic when variable batch sizes are needed.
train.exportParam.quantize: Quantization precision. FP32 is default; FP16 can reduce size and VRAM; INT8 needs calibration data.
train.exportParam.fraction: Dataset fraction used for INT8 calibration, from 0 to 1. Default uses all data.
train.exportParam.dynamic: Enable dynamic input size or batch. Useful for variable inputs, but may reduce backend optimization.
train.exportParam.nms: Include NMS post-processing in the exported model so deployment can use filtered predictions directly.
train.exportParam.simplify: Simplify the ONNX graph after export, usually removing redundant nodes.
train.exportParam.opset: ONNX opset version. Leave empty to let Ultralytics choose automatically.
train.exportParam.data: data.yaml for INT8 calibration. Manual export requires selecting it; auto export uses the current training dataset.
train.exportParam.device: Device used for ONNX export or quantization, for example cpu or GPU index 0.
train.exportParam.autoExport: Automatically export after training with the current settings. INT8 auto export uses the current training data.yaml.
train.tuningTips: Improve YOLO training by checking data quality and label consistency first, then tune imgsz, batch, lr0, momentum, and augmentation values. Larger batch sizes stabilize gradients but use more memory; lr0 controls initial learning speed; momentum controls update inertia; larger imgsz helps small targets but trains slower.
train.chartPlaceholder: Loss, mAP, precision, and recall curves will appear after training starts.
train.terminalPlaceholder: Training terminal output will appear here.
train.param.epochs: Number of training epochs. More epochs train longer, which may improve convergence but also risk overfitting.
train.param.batch: Batch size supports fixed integer, batch=-1 for automatic ~60% VRAM usage, or fraction (e.g. 0.70) for proportional automatic adjustment.
train.param.imgsz: Input image size for training. Must be one of 320, 416, 640, 800, 960, 1280, divisible by 32.
train.param.device: Training device. For multi-GPU use device=[0, 1] syntax.
train.param.amp: Automatic Mixed Precision. Disabled passes 0, enabled passes 1. Usually reduces GPU memory usage.
train.param.resume: Resume interrupted training from last.pt. Restores weights, optimizer state, LR scheduler, and epoch count.
train.param.workers: Number of worker threads for data loading. Higher values speed up preprocessing but may increase CPU usage. Set to 0 to use the main thread, which may be more stable on some systems.
train.param.cls_pw: Class weight power. 0 disables class weighting, 1 uses full inverse class frequency. Training page auto-initializes based on train set imbalance.
train.param.lr0: Initial learning rate. Too high may cause oscillations, too low leads to slow convergence.
train.param.momentum: Momentum parameter, affects smoothness of gradient updates.
train.param.patience: Number of epochs to wait without validation improvement before early stopping.
train.param.hsv_h: HSV hue augmentation magnitude, range 0-1, used to introduce color variation.
train.param.bgr: Probability of swapping image channels from RGB to BGR, range 0-1.
train.param.mosaic: Mosaic augmentation probability, combining four training images into one, range 0-1.
train.param.mixup: MixUp augmentation probability, blending two images and labels, range 0-1.
train.param.cutmix: CutMix augmentation probability, mixing partial regions from two images, range 0-1.
train.param.copy_paste: Copy-Paste augmentation probability, mainly for segmentation tasks, range 0-1.
train.param.copy_paste_mode: Copy-Paste strategy. Options: flip or mixup.
train.param.auto_augment: Automatic augmentation policy for classification. Options: randaugment, autoaugment, or augmix.
train.param.erasing: Random erasing probability for classification tasks, range 0-1.

detect.camHelpXGrad: XGrad-CAM uses normalized gradient weights to improve consistency between activations and the target score.
detect.camHelpScore: ScoreCAM evaluates activation maps through repeated forward passes without gradients, but is usually slower.
detect.deviceHelp: Auto prefers NVIDIA CUDA, then Intel GPU/NPU/CPU through exported OpenVINO models, then CPU. OpenVINO requires selecting a *_openvino_model or .xml model.
